driver: held-out ground check on the scale-test crops

rulesSummary.crops: status "scored" in results/scale_test_r1.json; grid 100 x 100 cells of 1 m
rulesSummary.definitions: split, build, cell error, edge error, hidden edges, end edges and questions 1-3 as in ablation/heldout_check.cjs
rulesSummary.primary: question 2: d = mean hidden-edge error - mean end-edge error per promoted span with held-out data on both; spans pooled over crops within a seed; S = share with d > 0
rulesSummary.bootstrap: 2000 replicates resampling whole crops, xorshift32 seed 20261109 (restarted per split seed and crop set), 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles by linear interpolation
rulesSummary.reading: interval wholly above 50 %: hidden larger; contains 50 %: no difference shown; wholly below 50 %: hidden smaller
rulesSummary.question1: crops with at least 30 measured cells in each class; rise is strict; Spearman rho between support and cell error per crop
rulesSummary.question3: share of endpoint-solid spans EC-DP downgrades whose largest edge error exceeds the pooled median of those it keeps (median recomputed in each replicate)
rulesSummary.reported: median over seeds of each per-seed value
rulesSummary.sensitivity: the same without surveys white-sands-parent and estonia-parent
